# Weekly sync — platform team

**Date:** Thursday, 9 October
**Attendees:** Priya, Tomasz, Lena, Okonkwo, Rui (notes)
**Absent:** Dana (on leave until the 20th)

---

## 1. Incident review: checkout latency on Monday

*Summary.* Between 14:05 and 14:52 UTC the p95 latency of `POST /checkout` rose from roughly 180 ms to 2.4 s. No orders were lost, but about 3% of requests timed out on the client.

*What we know:*

- The trigger was a schema migration that added an index to `orders` while traffic was at its daily peak.
- The migration tool took a lock we did not expect. The staging run did not show this because the staging table has ~40k rows instead of 90 million.
- Alerting worked: the page fired after 4 minutes. Rollback took longer than it should have (31 minutes) because the runbook pointed at the old dashboard.

*Actions:*

- [ ] **Tomasz** — rewrite the migration to use `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY`; re-run on Tuesday night
- [ ] **Lena** — fix the runbook link and add a "how to cancel a running migration" section
- [x] **Priya** — post the customer-facing summary (done Tuesday)

## 2. Moving CI to the new runners

Okonkwo shared numbers from the two-week trial:

| Metric                     | Old runners | New runners | Change  |
|----------------------------|-------------|-------------|---------|
| Median build time          | 11 min 20 s | 6 min 45 s  | −40%    |
| Queue time at 10:00        | 3 min 10 s  | 25 s        | −87%    |
| Flaky test reruns per day  | 14          | 9           | −36%    |
| Cost per 1,000 builds      | $212        | $187        | −12%    |

Discussion: everyone is in favour. Lena raised one concern: the new images do not include the legacy Java 11 toolchain that the `billing-export` job still needs. Options are (a) add it to the image, (b) pin that one job to the old runners until it is migrated.

> **Decision:** go with (b). We switch the default on 20 October and keep the old pool alive for one job until the end of the quarter.
